notes: Renders a `<div role="tabpanel">`, hidden when its value is not the selection.

`aria-labelledby` pointing at its tab is NOT generated, for the same reason `aria-controls` is not generated on TabItem: the reference crosses a component boundary and `namedBy` can only name a sibling part.

It declares `member` of the same collection as TabItem. `collection.items` names ONE component, so Tabs cannot say that both are members — the emitter accepts it only because it never validates the ancestor's `items` against a panel.
